request.query: My NexaHome loan was sanctioned on 30 June 2026. What processing fee applies to that sanction?

response.answer: Because your loan was sanctioned before 2026-07-01, it keeps the processing fee that applied at sanction [1]: 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, minimum ₹5,000 and maximum ₹15,000, plus 18% GST [2].

citations.quote: Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction
Processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST.
All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally.

request.query: What is the current processing fee for a NexaHome Loan?

response.answer: For a NexaHome Loan sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01, the processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, with a minimum of ₹5,000 and maximum of ₹10,000, plus GST [1]. GST is 18% [2]. For a loan sanctioned before that date, the fee that applied at sanction remains; under POL-HL-V3, that fee was 0.35%, minimum ₹5,000 and maximum ₹15,000, plus GST [1][2].

citations.quote: 3.1 Revised clause 6.2. Processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹10,000, plus GST.

5.1 Loans covered. The revised processing fee applies only to loans sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01. Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction, and no refund or adjustment is made.
The earlier terms were 0.35%, minimum ₹5,000 and maximum ₹15,000.
6.1 General. All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally.

request.query: I was sanctioned in March 2026 and want to prepay ₹12,000. Is that allowed?

response.answer: If your NexaHome loan was sanctioned under POL-HL-V3, ₹12,000 is allowed if you opt in to the revised minimum by written request to your branch or through a service request. [1] Until you opt in, the ₹25,000 minimum applies, although part prepayment is allowed at any time. [1][2]

citations.quote: Borrowers whose NexaHome loans were sanctioned under POL-HL-V3 before 2026-07-01 may opt in to the revised ₹10,000 part prepayment minimum by written request to their branch or through a service request.
Until a borrower opts in, the ₹25,000 minimum continues to apply to that loan.
Part prepayment is allowed at any time. The minimum part prepayment amount is ₹25,000.

request.query: Is there a foreclosure charge on a NexaFlex personal loan?

response.answer: Yes. No foreclosure is permitted before 6 EMIs have been paid; after the lock-in, the charge is 4.00% of the outstanding principal plus GST [1].

citations.quote: No prepayment or foreclosure is permitted before 6 EMIs have been paid.
After the lock-in, foreclosure attracts a charge of 4.00% of the outstanding principal plus GST.
